title: One corrupt block in the primary repository
description: After three good nights, one byte of one block of the primary repository is flipped (input/damage.json says which). The registry still holds a successful drill of that snapshot.
pass_criterion: Verdict FAILED, exit code 3, finding block_corrupt on repo_a and its newest snapshot; the damaged file is named and only that file; the fallback on the secondary repository is declared and verifies; the independent reference agrees on both repositories.
lesson: A past successful drill says nothing about today; the drill restores again and the fallback is said out loud.
